title.zh: 唯品会同款与金融级 IPLC 专线真相：如何鉴别假专线与公网直连套壳虚标？
title.en: Detecting Fake IPLC Proxies: How to Identify Public Relays Masquerading as Financial Circuits

cluster.zh: IPLC 纯专线与全球节点集群

description.zh: 揭秘市面上滥用“金融级专线”、“唯品会同款专线”标签的虚假营销黑幕，提供 4 种通过 traceroute 探针路由跃点、连续 ping 抖动方差与晚高峰丢包突变鉴别真伪专线的硬核实测法。
description.en: Exposing widespread fake marketing around "financial-grade IPLC" circuits, providing 4 technical verification methods including traceroute hop inspection, ping jitter variance, and peak-hour packet drop audits.
